releaseNotes.intro: You last opened v{from}. Since then:
v477: The story continues past the wolf hunt. Yamato said to expect to be contacted later, and now he means it: a day after you collect your reward, his own commission is waiting on the lodge board.
A new quest, The Pack Leader, opens a third scene in the southern forest. Every wolf you have fought so far was a Weakened Wolf; what dens in the hollow is the one that never was.
The Wolf Mask can finally be obtained. It had no drop, recipe, or vendor anywhere in the game.
Running no longer makes your energy drain creep up for good, and the running titles now discount the running cost itself: 0.095 per second at 5%, 0.085 at 15%.
Run no longer disappears from the Actions panel, and a shop's buying price and reputation sit on the bottom edge of the panel again.

mumy.name: Mummy
mumy.desc: Ancient corpses infused with the power of Dark

ghl.name: Ghoul
ghl.desc: Ghouls lurk in the Catacombs, longing for human flesh. Attacking their heads proves effective

ght.name: Ghast
ght.desc: The living dead, given power by demons of the Underworld

zmbf.name: Zombie Fighter
zmbf.desc: Corpses of common soldiers, brought back to life through the Dark's taint

zmbk.name: Zombie Knight
zmbk.desc: Zombies of the Knights of the Cross, still in possession of potent martial skills

zmbm.name: Zombie Mage
zmbm.desc: Zombies of Dark mages, who employ powerful offensive magic

skl.name: Skeleton
skl.desc: Skeletal remains of zombie corpses. They lurk in darkness to attack the living

slm1.name: Blue Slime
slm1.desc: Lesser slimes, devoid of any senses. They survive by absorbing debris from the ground

slm2.name: Green Slime
slm2.desc: Small forest slimes. They hide in leaves and grass

rbt1.name: Wild Rabbit
rbt1.desc: Docile rabbits, often found in plains and woods. They're difficult to catch

slm3.name: Cyan Slime
slm3.desc: Brightly colored slime. It looks like it can perfectly reflect the sky

slm4.name: Clear Slime
slm4.desc: Weird transparent slime, bearing no distinct color. They can hide anywhere and are very difficult to notice

kksh.name: Scarecrow
kksh.desc: Once protector of fields, this figure has turned to evil by the influence of Dark. It hangs still in ambush, waiting for unsuspecting passersby

golem1.name: Straw Golem
golem1.desc: Big golem composed of straw. These golems are brittle and weak, their main purpose is to assist newbies in training

golem2.name: Reinforced Straw Golem
golem2.desc: This golem's joints have been binded by the rope, giving it sturdier and more stable frame

golem3.name: Paper Golem
golem3.desc: Slim golem made of paper-like material. While not as tough as other training golems, it has a light body which allows it to move faster

golem4.name: Attack Golem
golem4.desc: Golem with implanted martial prowess. Somewhat similar to a trained militant, they pose a dangerous threat to any unprepared opponent

lrck.name: Locked Rock
lrck.desc: A rock shaped monster found in caves and dungeons. It has a habit of closing of paths by mimicking a wall, but it's fighting prowess is close to zero.

lsprt.name: Lamp Spirit
lsprt.desc: Small fire sprites that manifest inside oil lamps located in mines and other places with low human activity. While not sinister by nature, they enjoy playing pranks on people

dcrps1.name: Disaster Corpse
dcrps1.desc: Undead bodies manifested purely by death ki. They appear in ancient battlefields or other areas with extremely heavy concentration of dark ki. These corpses share countless memories of residue souls

unsctn.name: Unchanging Skeleton
unsctn.desc: People that neither die nor dissolve, active in the world but don't have minds or memories. They won't hurt people other than pulling pranks and causing trouble, but would go frenzy if exposed to death ki for too long

wolf1.name: Weakened Wolf
wolf1.desc: Wolves affected by a disease or other negative influences. While not nearly as dangerous as its healthy counterpart, even in such a low state they pose danger to those who aren't careful

slm5.name: Blue Slime
slm5.desc: Slime of a very deep darkblue hue, which looks shiny under the light and almost completely dark in the shade

wolfa1.name: Pack Leader
wolfa1.desc: The one wolf in the southern forest that no disease touched. It is larger than the rest, but that is not what kept it alive: it held the pack between itself and something else, and whatever that was has left its mark in the rot along its jaw

test1.name: Beast killer
test1.desc: Attacks against beast type creatures are 30% more effective

psnwrd2.name: Venom block
psnwrd2.desc: Severe poisons have no effect on you

rested.name: Rested

stk2.name: Sharpened Stick

knf1.name: Wooden Knife

knf2.name: Rusty Dagger

ktn2.name: Red Katana
ktn2.desc: Polished rusty katana. Still nearly useless in a fight

trch.name: Torch
trch.desc: Used to light up dark places or for burning up thing

twg.name: Dry Twig
twg.desc: With this you can pretend you're a wizard

bknf.name: Battle Knife
bknf.desc: A good dagger for the novice

skknf.name: Scramasax
skknf.desc: A good knife for both combat and daily use
skknf.desc_2: Cursed knife capable of rapturing the soul

drknf.name: Dirk
drknf.desc: A steady knife you can depend on

kdknf.name: Kudi
kdknf.desc: A dangerous dagger with a curved blade

krsnf.name: Kris
krsnf.desc: An exotic dagger with a wavy blade

kkknf.name: Khukuri
kkknf.desc: A knife with a heavy, curved blade

bdknf.name: Baselard

stknf.desc: A stabbing dagger with a thin, sharp blade

jmknf.name: Jamadhar

rbknf.name: Ribsplitter

ekmw.desc: Also known as "Hiking Stick". Sturdy, used for support while travelling on foot in forests, mountains, through the snow, water, or any other difficult to navigate landscape

mnkm.name: Menokamakiri
mnkm.desc: Short knife, designed for women. Light and durable, functions like a hunting knife

wsrd1.name: Wooden Sword
wsrd1.desc: Simple long sword carved from light wood. Easy to handle and is suitable as amateurish training weapon

wsrd2.name: Bamboo Training Sword
wsrd2.desc: A training sword for kenjutsu lessons. Designed in the late Edo period, it is strung together from four bamboo planks. The ruthless chief of a female bandit group named Danfu is known to wield it

nssrd.name: Short Sword
nssrd.desc: Short crude sword designed for self-defence. It's not that useful in battle, especially in unskilled hands

heyit.name: Heiyoto
heyit.desc: Nothing flashy or noticeable about his sword. It reflects the samurai spirit

fksrd.name: Fake Sword
fksrd.desc: The sword is made of bamboo. Poorer ronin sometimes pretend to be full-fledged samurai with this

tkmts.name: Takemitsu
tkmts.desc: This reinforced sword is made of bamboo. Not much as a weapon, but makes you seem stronger

bsrd.name: Blunt Sword
bsrd.desc: This is the blunt sword used as a bad example of a knife in demonstration sales for housewives. Good luck trying to cut onions with this

bdsrd.name: Dull Sword
bdsrd.desc: A sword designed for mass production by reducing labor and material cost down to a minimum. It may look like a sword, but it's not really fit to cut anything. The manual suggests it be used to cut radishes

bcsrd.name: Crappy Sword
bcsrd.desc: This sword is sold at the 100 Cout store under the name "Big Loss". You get what you pay for. There are even competitions to see who can sharpen this sword the best

ktsk.name: Kotesaki
ktsk.desc: A light sword a ight-heartet guy begged the swordsmith to make. He thought his sword would make him more popular with the ladies. He managed to rack up some wins by cheating, but the ladies still don't like him

crsto.name: Cristo
crsto.desc: A samurai wrongly imprisoned for a crime he didn't commit carved this weapon from his cell walls. He did this in a secret from the guards, but by the time he finished, his sentence was over

ksbmr.name: Komusubimaru
ksbmr.desc: A swordsman who loves sumo made this sword to cheer on his favorite sumo wrestler. But the name "Komusubi" is a low rank in sumo. It was bad luck, and the wrestler never got promoted

hsmts.name: Hasemitsu
hsmts.desc: A swordsmith created this blade as he danced around bragging about his skill. You may think he was just screwing around, but this sword is actually quiet nice

kiknif.name: Kitchen Knife
kiknif.desc: A knife originally used to cut fish, not people. It's not a sword, but ordering one won't get you yelled at

gamas.name: Gama
gamas.desc: A man's wife who had a face that resembles a frog died, so he hired a medium to do a seance to summon his wife's spirit. But the medium summoned the spirit of some toad. The husband used this sword to kill the medium

wsdmbld.name: Wisdom Blade
wsdmbld.desc: This is the sword used by a serial killer that struck fear in Edo. The killer stole his family sword to do his killing, so you can imagine that things got weird at the house when they found the sword missing

kurum.name: Kuruma
kurum.desc: This is the sword used by a great tengu when he taught Ushiwakamaru how to fight at Mt. Kuruma. Ushiwakamaru is trained to fight and also became great at the pommel horse

hrsm.name: Harusame
hrsm.desc: A sword made in the quiet rain in spring. It is easy to wield and can be chewy. When dried, it won't be as sharp, but putting water turns it back to normal

kosgi.name: Kosugi
kosgi.desc: A sword used by the famous ninja who left the country and took and extremely dangerous mission. This sword encompasses his very being

shiran.name: Shiran
shiran.desc: Its name comes from its purple orchid-like accessory. The true etymology of the sword is a mystery to even its swordsmith

shnztt.name: Shinzanto
shnztt.desc: Those who wield this sword also command the shaky nervousness of the rookie blacksmith who crafted it

lsrd.name: Light Sword
lsrd.desc: A basic, easy to wield civilian-level light sword

log.name: Log
log.desc: A massive heavy tree log. How did you even think about swinging it as a weapon?

sprw.name: Spear
sprw.desc: Long piece of wood with a sharp metal chunk at the end of it. Couldn't get simpler than that

gsprw.name: Guard Spear
gsprw.desc: Basic and easy to wield spear used in self-defence

scspt1.name: Red Hand
scspt1.desc: Burning sword that looks like a scissors blade. Its flames can evaporate any liquid

scspt2.name: Blue Hand
scspt2.desc: Freezing sword that looks like a scissors blade. Its edge can calm the fieriest fire

scspt3.name: Fate Cutters
scspt3.desc: Two swords combined together, forming a scissors-shaped weapon. It is said a mad blacksmith created this blade to hunt demigods

shrsb.name: Shears
shrsb.desc: Massive gardening shears, for tiding up the bushes and other decorative flora. A murderer in the past was known to commit atrocities with a similar tool

evob.name: Sword Of Evolution
evob.desc: This living blade can absorb the blood and souls of defeated foes, it gets sharper with each kill

mkrdwk.name: Marked Wakizashi
mkrdwk.desc: Old wakizashi variant with red hilt. Scarred and chipped blade hints that it was used rather heavily in the past

bnd.name: Bandana
bnd.desc: Thin cloth bandana. It protects your face from sweat

gnt.name: Gauntlet
gnt.desc: Tough leather gauntlet that covers your entire hand. May prevent you from losing fingers

A cute wolf mask.

bmsk.name: Frog Mask

A cute frog mask.

cmsk.name: Cat Mask

dmsk.name: Dog Mask
dmsk.desc:
A cute dog mask.

nkgd.name: Neck Guard
nkgd.desc: Metal plating worn around the neck. Minor protection from direct frontal attacks

sndl.name: Sandals
sndl.desc: Cheap unremarkable sandals made from light leather. Aren't even that comfortable to wear

ykkr.name: Yukker
ykkr.desc: Warm deerskin boots, worn by civilians and hunters during winter for maximum protection from cold and environmental hazards

tnc.name: Tunic
tnc.desc: A simple, short-sleeved shirt. It's somewhat short in length and tailored to snugly fit the wearer's body

rncp.name: Rain Cap
rncp.desc: The cap with the wide brim for keeping the rain from the wearer's eyes

rnss.name: Rain Shoes
rnss.desc: Simple shoes made from tree rubber. Sturdy and longlasting, they protect one's toes from cold

hkgd.name: Headguard
hkgd.desc: A simple and light helmet that provides minimal protection against falling debris and the like

wkss.name: Worker Shoes
wkss.desc: Safety shoes for laborers. The metal reinforcement offers dependable protection for the toes

jhmt.name: Junk Helmet
jhmt.desc: A helmet clobbled together from scrap material. It looks terribly heavy but provides good protection around the head and neck

knkn.name: Knit Knee-Highs
knkn.desc: Long boots woven from linen. Light and breathable, so they're comfortable when it's hot

brbn.name: Burnouns
brbn.desc: A long, hooded cloak. Protetcs the wearer from both the scorching sun and chilling cold

ovrl.name: Overalls
ovrl.desc: Work clothes made of heavy cloth that cover the entire body. Protects from bumps and scratches

prsnu.name: Prison Uniform
prsnu.desc: Made of ugly, coarse cloth, this garment's sturdiness is its only redeeming trait. It holds up well under what washing it does get

prsna.name: Prison Apparel
prsna.desc: It looks just like any other prison uniform, but the neck, sleeves and elbows have been made far more comfortable with soft threads

strwks.name: Straw Kasa
strwks.desc: A Sando-gasa is made by weaving straw together. Great for boys who are too embarrassed to use a parasol

reedhd.name: Reed Hood
reedhd.desc: A hat that covers the face of Zen monks made from woven reed. Wearing this doesn't necessarily make you a monk, though

ptchct.name: Patchwork Coat
ptchct.desc: Coat stitched together from patches of cloth of various sizes and thickness. Somewhat durable but looks desperate

ptchpts.name: Patchwork Pants
ptchpts.desc: Crude attempt at pants, very baggy looking and somewhat uncomfortable to wear. Potential holes near stitch areas make your lower body shiver when it's windy

bkl.name: Buckler
bkl.desc: Tiny shield that is supposed to be strapped onto an arm. Low defence, but provides high mobility

tge.name: Targe
tge.desc: Simple square shield with reinforced corners

plt.name: Pelta Shield
plt.desc: Triangular shield composed of several layers of wood banded together, making it a little on the heavy side

qad.name: Quad Shield
qad.desc: Four planks braced crosswise behind a hide face. Cheap, square, and honest about being both

crc.name: Circle Shield
crc.desc: A plain disc of banded wood with an iron boss at the centre, meant to be punched forward as much as held

rnd.name: Round Shield
rnd.desc: The shield a village militia is handed: wide enough to hide behind, light enough to carry all day

twr.name: Tower Shield
twr.desc: Tall enough to set on the ground and stand behind. Nothing gets past it and neither do you, quickly

spk.name: Spiked Shield
spk.desc: A round shield with a spike run through the boss, for a man who would rather not stop moving forward

kit.name: Kite Shield
kit.desc: Tapered to a point at the bottom so it covers a leg without fouling it. Made for a rider, useful on foot
kit.desc_2: The lid of a large cooking pot, still smelling faintly of what was under it. It will turn one blow, maybe, and it does not mind fire

htr.name: Heater Shield
htr.desc: A flat-topped shield cut down from the older shape, small enough to see over and still cover the chest

ovl.name: Oval Shield
ovl.desc: An oval of layered hide over a light frame, curved to slide a blow off to one side rather than stop it

knt.name: Knight Shield
knt.desc: Steel shield tapering to a point, evenly made and well balanced. Nothing about it was improvised

hpt.name: Hoplite Shield
hpt.desc: Large round shield of bronze faced over wood, made to be held in a line beside other men rather than carried alone

jrt.name: Jazeraint Shield
jrt.desc: Small plates riveted onto a quilted backing, overlapping like scales. Heavier to carry than to be hit through

drd.name: Dread Shield
drd.desc: Blackened shield the dark seems reluctant to settle on. Cold to hold, and heavier than its size accounts for

stksld.name: Stake Shield
stksld.desc: Not actually a shield, but a row of spiky wood stakes tightly packed together to form a square panel. It's a bit heavy

strawp.name: Straw Pendant
strawp.bonus:
+50 to max energy
SPD +1

snch.name: Sun Charm
snch.desc: Little charm with a piece of power of the Sun imbued into it. It absorbs Sun energy

mnch.name: Moon Charm
mnch.desc: Little charm with a piece of power of the Moon imbued into it. It absorbs Moon energy

mstn.name: Mana Stone
mstn.desc: Gem imbued with raw arcanic power

bstn.name: Blood Stone
bstn.desc: Gem imbued with the power of blood

sstn.name: Soul Stone
sstn.desc: Gem with a fraction of a soul trapped inside of it

trrng.name: Trinity

gmfr2.name: Ifrit Carnelian

gmea1.name: Gnome Emerald

gmea2.name: Dao Moonstone

gmdk2.name: Berial Blackpearl

wfng.desc: Menacing fang of the wolf, in the form of a pendant. Wearing this can help to repell and scare away minor beasts

wfar.name: Wolf Array

cclth.name: Cheap Cloth
cclth.desc: A poor quality swatch of cloth. Unstitches when you so much as breathe on it

thrdnl.name: Thread
thrdnl.desc: A small quantity of thread that could be used in sewing and tailoring projects

sktbad.name: Mistake
sktbad.desc: A failed product of an unskilled artisan. Once destined to become something worty of display, this mangled mess is repulsive to look at

dfish.name: Dead Fish
dfish.desc: Carcass of some fish, looking bad, grey and dead. Can be dismantled into fishbait

fbait1.name: Bait
fbait1.desc: Organic remains rolled into a ball, favoured by fish and other aquatic population

htrdvr.name: Hunter's Crate
htrdvr.desc: Heavy wooden crate you were asked to deliver to dojo. It is sealed shut and you can't look inside. It smells faintly of meat, spices and mushrooms. Probably filled with preserved dry produce

htrsvr.name: Hunter's Bag
htrsvr.desc: Heavy canvas bag you were asked to deliver to the herbalist. It is filled with separated bundles of various herbs you can't identify. You'd rather not touch anything inside as it looks dangerously poisonous

hbtsvr.name: Herbalist's Satchel
hbtsvr.desc: Heavy leather satchel you were asked to deliver to the head hunter. Hundreds of vials clang Violently no matter how carefully you attempt to carry it

fwdpile.name: Firewood Pile
fwdpile.desc: Stockpile of firewood neatly packed together for easy storage

lprmt.name: Travel Permit
lprmt.desc: Written document used in your village. Acts as a proof of one's strength, meaning the owner has the ability to protect himself when leaving the village, you will need this when going out. Nearly every adult you know has this

wfng.name: Wolf Fang
wfng.desc: Clear and sharp fang of a predator. It still looks dangerous

dmice1.name: Dead Mouse
dmice1.desc: Vermin hunted by your cat, now proudly displayed before you

dbdc1.name: Dead Bird
dbdc1.desc: A proof of loyalty brought to you by your cat

ip1.name: "Idea paper"
ip1.desc: Tiny scrap of paper with information. You wrote it yourself to remember things.

skl1.name: P Skillbook (Swords)
skl1.desc: Entry level practitioner skillbook about sword combat{separator}Sword Mastery EXP gain +5%

skl2.name: P Skillbook (Knives)
skl2.desc: Entry level practitioner skillbook about knife combat{separator}Knife Mastery EXP gain +5%

skl3.name: P Skillbook (Axes)
skl3.desc: Entry level practitioner skillbook about axe combat{separator}Axe Mastery EXP gain +5%

skl4.name: P Skillbook (Spears)
skl4.desc: Entry level practitioner skillbook about spear combat{separator}Polearm Mastery EXP gain +5%

skl5.name: P Skillbook (Hammers)
skl5.desc: Entry level practitioner skillbook about hammer combat{separator}Hammer Mastery EXP gain +5%

skl6.name: P Skillbook (Martial)
skl6.desc: Entry level practitioner skillbook about unarmed combat{separator}Martial Mastery EXP gain +5%

bstr.name: "Animalis Vicipaedia"
bstr.desc: Heavy Hunter's Encyclopedia. There are a few entries about wild life, beasts, and mythical creatures you can encounter, the other pages are blank. You feel the urge to fill them in{separator}Unlocks Bestiary

tbrwdb.name: "The Art of Teabrewing"
tbrwdb.desc: Informative little book in detail describing the ways of teamaking, starting from precise amounts and proportions, specific water temperatures, correct tableware, to the defferent styles and etiquette

msc1.name: "Book of Fairy Tales"
msc1.desc: An amusing collection of folklore featuring the usual cast of fairies and demons{separator}{extra}

bcpn.name: "Cooking with Poison"
bcpn.desc: A leatherbound book with an embossed cauldron on the cover. Inside it describes ways to purify food through alchemy

mdc1.name: "First Aid Manual"
mdc1.desc: Tiny red pocket-sized guide to emergency care, covers basic bandaging and wound treating

dmkbk.name: "Dollmaker's Handbook"
dmkbk.desc: A very short manual filled with illustrations about primitive dollmaking. The instructions are easy to understand so children could make the dolls too. Looks like there was a chapter dedicated to sewing, now it's almost entirely missing

scrlw.name: "Ragged Parchment"
scrlw.desc: Scummy sheet of paper tainted with something teal. Some kinds of materials are listed here

wp2s.name: "Rotten Illustration"
wp2s.desc: Found this within old bushery, it looks like a drawing of something in charcoal

shppmf.name: "Pamphlet"
shppmf.desc: This was shoved onto you by someone on the streets. Store names, discount prices, hot items... An entire wall of advertisements in tiny letters, to fit as much of it as possible on this piece of paper. It is a good idea to memorize the addresses

amrthsck.name: "Guide To Living By Yourself"
amrthsck.desc: Looks like a page from someone's notebook, marked "H", poorly written in bad handwriting. It lists several simple things you can cook and make from widely available cheap materials

skl1a.name: "Bladesman Manual"
skl1a.desc: Technique book full of fundamental knowledge about swordfighting{separator}Sword Mastery EXP gain +15%

skl2a.name: "Assassin Manual"
skl2a.desc: Technique book full of fundamental knowledge about kinfefighting{separator}Knife Mastery EXP gain +15%

skl3a.name: "Axeman Manual"
skl3a.desc: Technique book full of fundamental knowledge about axefighting{separator}Axe Mastery EXP gain +15%

skl4a.name: "Lancer Manual"
skl4a.desc: Technique book full of fundamental knowledge about spearfighting{separator}Polearm Mastery EXP gain +15%

skl5a.name: "Clubber Manual"
skl5a.desc: Technique book full of fundamental knowledge about bluntfighting{separator}Hammer Mastery EXP gain +15%

skl6a.name: "Brawler Manual"
skl6a.desc: Technique book full of fundamental knowledge about fistfighting{separator}Martial Mastery EXP gain +15%

brdbn.name: "Your First Bread"
brdbn.desc: Very primitive instruction booklet about making simple breads. The way it's written, it looks very similar to manuals given to slaves and servants at the beginning of their service, if they are able to read

bfsnwt.name: "Beggar Fashion"
bfsnwt.desc: Some nonsence illustration with a name, featuring a group of peasants in rags posing awkwardly. What even is this?

pdeedhs.name: "Property Deed"
pdeedhs.desc: This old looking legal document indentifies you as a sole owner of this broken down hut you live in. It was passed down to you by your ancestors, you speculate{separator}Allows you to list and examine your possessions

fgtsb1.name: "Street Fighting"
fgtsb1.desc: Someone's observational notes of street gangs and their violent encounters. There's an amusing essay about dirty tricks in the front section{separator}Fighting EXP gain +15%

jnlbk.name: "Empty Journal"
jnlbk.desc: Dusty old tome, pure as snow and untainted by ink. Feels like it was purified by magic. When you gaze upon it, you are compelled to record your encounters and anything else that you find important and crucial for your adventures{separator}Unlocks Journal

fwd1.name: Firewood Gathering
fwd1.desc: Secure 10 bundles of firewood for hunter Yamato

hnt1.name: First Hunt
hnt1.desc: Hunt for 10 peices of meat for hunter Yamato

grds1.name: Guarding Duty
grds1.desc: You were tasked with guarding duty to watch over marketplace

lmfstkil1.name: Monster Eradication
lmfstkil1.desc: Dangerous monsters have invaded the southern forest and terrorizing the villagers. Get rid of them!

pckld1.name: The Pack Leader
pckld1.desc: Yamato kept his word and sent for you. The wolves you killed were starving and sick; something drove them north. Find the hollow past the foliage, and look before you kill

undcty1.name: Beneath the Village
undcty1.desc: The old shopkeeper by the cellars has been saying for a month that something is digging under people's homes, and nobody believed him. Yamato sent you to hear him out properly. Find out what the village already knows before you decide it is monsters

undcty2.name: The End of Journey
undcty2.desc: Yamato wants to know how far the passage under the village goes, and what is at the bottom of the part a man can walk with a candle. Take everything you can carry

nrvs1.name: The Man Who Said Nothing
nrvs1.desc: The nervous man at the market stalls has something he has been carrying for fourteen months, and he will only say it to someone who once let him alone instead of pressing him

fgt.name: Fighting
fgt.desc: Ability to perform better in a fight

twoh.desc: Ability to fight using heavy two handed weapons
twoh.bonus: <small style="color:darkorange">Slightly increases attack power when holding a two handed weapon</small>

trad.desc: Ability to exchange wealth for goods and services
trad.bonus: <small style="color:darkorange">Slightly shifts shop prices in your favour</small>

swm.desc: Ability to dive and traverse waters

dssmb.name: Disassembly
dssmb.desc: Ability to deconstruct goods into raw spare parts

drka.name: Drinking
drka.desc: Ability to tolerate and enjoy alcoholic beverages

ptnc.name: Patience
ptnc.desc: Ability to endure forms of suffering without complaint

scout.name: Perception
scout.desc: Ability to see the unseen and better understand your surroundings

tlrng.name: Tailoring
tlrng.desc: Abillity to sew and create produce out of cloth

crptr.name: Corruption Resistance
crptr.desc: Ability to resist the corruption of flesh

hst.name: Harvesting
hst.desc: Ability to find and collect usable materials from the surroundings
hst.bonus: <small style="color:darkorange">Increases chances of obtaining area loot</small>

coldr.name: Cold Resistance
coldr.desc: Ability to tolerate harsh and cold temperatures
coldr.bonus: <small style="color:darkorange">Slightly decreases energy loss when cold</small>

new.name: Nobody
new.desc: Unremarkable someone trying to find his purpose in life

inn.name: Initiate
inn.desc: Dojo disciple who managed to finish the first training stages. Woo!

thr.name: Thrasher
thr.desc: The one who destroyed dojo's precious equipment. Were you a bit older you'd pay the expences, but you made your teacher proud.

wsl.name: Wolf Slayer
wsl.desc: You went alone against a pack of feral wolves. That amounts to something!

knf.name: Butterfly
knf.desc: You always thought knives were cool. You aren't nearly precise with your knifework yet, But you will learn

bll.name: Bully
bll.desc: You have graduated from being a mere Weakling. You feel powerful! You still find it difficult to stand your own in a fight

cvl.name: Civilian
cvl.desc: You're not very suitable for combat. But you think you're out of options

stk.name: Stick Kid
stk.desc: You always liked swinging that thing around. You think you're beginning to understand how to land hits properly. Or not

fgt.name: Fighter
fgt.desc: You begin to start liking to fight! At the very least you can now somewhat defend yourself against mild threats and not just die in one hit

pbg.name: Weakling
pbg.desc: You can't really hit anything with these frail arms of yours

brw.name: Brawler
brw.desc: You feel like you can pack a punch! And recieve one. You're starting to feel a bit more comfortable with your bare fists

stb.name: Stabber
stb.desc: Even if it's a smaller tool compared to any other weapon, you've learned how to make knives useful for self-defence, since they are somewhat easier to handle than the rest. You can hit vitals better too

slp1.name: Sleeper
slp1.desc: You really like sleeping don't you? You spend a lot of time in your bed

slp2.name: Heavy Sleeper
slp2.desc: You learned to sleep very soundly, without any care for the outside world. Your body begins to adapt and grow stronger with every break you take

tcvl.name: Trained Civilian
tcvl.desc: You're still nearly useless in a real fight, but you have learned to at least move out of the way of danger

plm.name: Prick
plm.desc: You found it fun to make little holes in plant leaves and look through them at the Sun. You think this could be morbidly useful in a fight

wlk.name: Walker
wlk.desc: All this walking around feels very beneficial for your body

eat1.name: Starving Child
eat1.desc: You've been all skin and bones as long as you can remember. You will need to start eating properly if you wish to survive

eat2.name: Hungry Child
eat2.desc: You begin to gain some weight eating all this boring and dry food. But you're not complaining, at least you live

eat4.name: Satiated
eat4.desc: Being full is good, but you start to wonder what kinds of different dishes exist in the world

eat5.name: Mini-Gourmand
eat5.desc: You begin to understand the importance of tasty food! You crave the larger variety

cck.name: Campfire Cook
cck.desc: Not something to brag about, but you won't completely starve to death if you find yourself in the wilds without a proper meal
cck.tdesc: Lets you cook recipes without the fixture they call for

rok.name: Rookie
rok.desc: A novice fighter. You have a knack for martial arts but it doesn't amount to much yet

rnr.name: Runner
rnr.desc: Your body is in much better shape, so is your stamina. Moving around fast doesn't bother you as much anymore, but you spend your energy and get kind of hungry from it

jgg.name: Jogger
jgg.desc: Simply walking doesn't cut it anymore, maybe you should speed up a bit while travelling on foot?

spn.name: Sprinter
spn.tdesc: Running consumes a further 12% less energy

ilt.name: Illiterate
ilt.desc: You have a really difficult time understanding even the basic writings. Even the signs outside the shops give you trouble

und.name: Uneducated
und.desc: You are not very friendly with books, your entire literature knowledge is nothing but simple kiddie stories and fairy tales

aaa.name: aaa
aaa.desc: They say that in the hands of a gosu with great inner ki, even a dead leaf can become a weapon that can pierce iron plates

eat3.name: Malnourished
eat3.desc: You are clearly undereating, yet, eating something other than bland untasty bread leaves you in a positive mood

srd1.name: Aspiring Ronin
srd1.desc: Watching swordplay of elder swordmasters always fascinated you, yet even trying to hold the sword properly is apparently extremely difficult. You are not the type to give up though

srd2.name: Sword Trainee
srd2.desc: You have only just began learning the Way of the Sword, which clearly shows. You still find it hard to wield the sword properly, let alone attempting to hit something with it

srd3.name: Squire
srd3.desc: All those thousand swings training sessions weren't for nothing. Now you can hold your sword somewhat straight and your posture got better. Hovewer, slashing things didn't get any easier

srd4.name: Blade for Hire
srd4.desc: Your swordplay has reached the rank of a common foot soldier. Or so you thought. Maybe you can match a lowest level mercenary, which isn't something to be proud of. You are still ways away from calling yourself a proper swordsman

lnc1.name: Spearholder
lnc1.desc: You have learned how the art of Spearmanship can be used for both offensive and defensive combat, which you think suits you pretty well. Hovewer, handling a spear with skill is much more difficult than you initially thought

lnc2.name: Village Militia
lnc2.desc: Your reflexes wielding a polearm got slightly better, at the very least you aren't dropping your weapon after every second swing anymore. You could be considered a part of a peasant spear group with your measly skills

lnc3.name: Phlanger
lnc3.desc: You're getting a hold of your primitive spearmanship, which is reasurring considering how much effort went into your training. You could be a part of the second-rate frontline military squad with your ability, but you will aim higher

hmr2.name: Basher
hmr2.desc: Squashing things with a hammer or a club may seem simple, but it does require some skill to do so properly and effectively. You understand the basics but lack the strength for it, though

hmr3.name: Heavy Hand
hmr3.desc: You favor strong blunt weaponry, which shows by how sturdy and hard your hands have become. This is good for your overall strength. You still lack any skill or technique, hovewer

kill1.name: Pest Control
kill1.desc: You have wiped out about 10000 creatures on your way. Most of them weren't living things though... right?

rspn1.name: Punching Bag
rspn1.desc: Getting beat up like this hurts like hell. You better think of a way out of this misery!

rfpn1.name: Garbage Eater
rfpn1.desc: All the time you had to consume disgusting rotten stuff is finally paying off... Kind of. You would rather avoid doing that in the future, if possible

rfpn2.name: Iron Stomach
rfpn2.desc: Going through these desperate times of having such an unsafe diet, your stomach doesn't feel as awful anymore. You really shouldn't be doing that
rfpn2.tdesc: Allows you to roughly guess when perishable food rots (shift key)

rfpn3.name: Omnivore
rfpn3.desc: It seems like you can eat a lot of awful stuff and feel fine afterwards. Is that really worth it? You think it is. The taste doesn't get any better though...
rfpn3.tdesc: Judges spoiled food even more finely (shift key)

tqtm.name: Quartermaster
tqtm.desc: You have returned more than 300 pieces of dojo supplies. How much of that stuff do they have?

ddw.name: Glass Bones
ddw.desc: Bizzarely, you got yourself knocked out by the weakest enemy in existence. How did that happen? You feel like you have achieved somewhat absurd understanding of how frail your body actually is. Perhaps violence isn't for you

neet.name: Hikikomori
neet.desc: You have spent an entire year at your house without going out even once. You were somewhat productive in your seclusion, but the time spent didn't even feel like a year, however...

aptc.name: Apprentice
aptc.desc: You have succesfully completed the second part of dojo's training courses. You are impressed by your own achievements!

sld1.name: Wimp
sld1.desc: The fear of pain has forced you to begin taking cover behind whatever you take your hands on. Shields fall within this category nicely, you think you should try learning how to handle them properly

sld2.name: Defender
sld2.desc: Even if you're still full of openings and have a terrible time adjusting to the weight of a shield you're holding, you can still manage to reflect the slowest, stupidest and the most direct attack you're facing. Sometimes

sld3.name: Protector
sld3.desc: You understand better how shields work, and your reaction time against frontal attacks has improved as well. Your openings are still plentiful, but you manage to stay alive

seye1.name: Bat Eyes
seye1.desc: Sometimes when you hit an enemy the certain way your attack feels somewhat stronger, you noticed. What's that about?

seye2.name: Suspicious Eyes
seye2.desc: You have confirmed it, bashing the enemy on the head makes your battles end slightly quicker. Is it only the head that does that?

pet1.name: Valley Cat
pet1.desc: Stray animals don't seem to be wary of you that much, for some reason. You are able to hug a random cat without it running away

pet2.name: Animal Friend
pet2.desc: Minor predators don't view you as a threat, which is good, but you don't want to bother them when they're hungry, though. You think you have a way to avoid the dangers of wild life, at least
pet2.tdesc: Your cat learns from you a little faster

dngs1.name: Wary
dngs1.desc: Sometimes when you're hit it hurts much more then usual. You hate this, but why does that happen? You have to figure out how to avoid this

dngs2.name: Careful
dngs2.desc: Avoiding hits to the vitals is much harder, as you found out. You must think of a way to take precautions to guarantee your own safety

rtr1.name: Coward
rtr1.desc: You can't stomach the thought of getting seriously injured at all. Running away from danger is where it's at

neet2.name: Shut In
neet2.desc: Staying home for a year was nothing, this time you went half a decade staying put in your comfortable living space, caring not for the outside world. You are not sure how you feel about nobody ever checking on you..

neet3.name: Hermit
neet3.desc: Tenth of century at home, you did it. What were you even doing in there? Sleeping? Cultivating? It doesn't matter, you can proudly call yourself a hermit and stay forgotten until you decide to show yourself in light again

coo1.name: Kitchen Nightmare
coo1.desc: Either cooking is a very difficult art, or you're just very bad at it. Leaving you alone in the kitchen is a recipe for disaster. But you won't become good without making some mistakes first

kill2.name: Sweeper
kill2.desc: Eliminating 50000 creatures like it was nothing made you wonder whether this realm is filled with weaklings or it is you who are simply too strong to handle. It is probably the former

kill3.name: Bone Collector
kill3.desc: Hack and slash! 200000 foes have fallen under mighty arm! You're getting a little too comfortable on your path of destruction

kill5.name: Sentinel
kill5.desc: 5 million deaths! You managed to undo the population of the small city. That's quiet a feat given your low power level

axc1.name: Hack
axc1.desc: Axes are difficult to handle, you learned. This isn't simply chpping firewood on a log, you a need hard grip and proper hand flexibility to fight with them efficiently

axc2.name: Chopper
axc2.desc: You feel strong when using axes in battles! You only feel that way, you are not any strong with it yet. It is difficut for you to find the right balance to swing that thing

dth1.name: Fallen
dth1.desc: Somehow you always escape life threatening situations even after being hit and bruised a lot, hovewer you still lose conciousness. Newbie's luck?

dth2.name: Decadent
dth2.desc: Often you manage to avoid death even after being heavily injured. Perhaps you have a very resilient body, or Heavens aren't willing to accept you yet

seye3.name: Dissector
seye3.desc: By slaying foes as much as you did, you learned how to quickly notice your enemies' weak points. This knowledge will allow you quickly and effectively dispose of those standing in your way

fmn1.name: Scrawny
fmn1.desc: You feel terrible. You might want to eat something or you'll end up being nothing more than a skeleton

fmn2.name: Bag Of Bones
fmn2.desc: Days of hunger took a toll on your body, yet made you learn to conserve your energy by other means, which shows. Just a bit

fmn3.name: Emaciated
fmn3.desc: Yesterdays's weakness is today's strength. Or so you've heard. You are not feeling as awful and weak by starving yourself, but there's still nothing to be proud of

shpt1.name: Third-Rate Shopper
shpt1.desc: You left the shop with half a thousand goods total. It's a tiny amount if you think about it - food, cooking ingredients, household tools

mone1.name: Beggar
mone1.desc: Acquiring a whole 1 Gold coin worth of money is a lot for someone as pathetic you. You could survive with that amount for a year!

geti1.name: Collector
geti1.desc: You cannot walk past something useful without picking it up

geti2.name: Packmule
geti2.desc: Your pack has stopped closing properly and you do not care

geti3.name: Hoarder
geti3.desc: Nothing is thrown away. Everything might be needed later

geti4.name: Treasure Hunter
geti4.desc: You have hauled home more than most caravans carry

tghs1.name: Scarred
tghs1.desc: You have taken enough hits to stop flinching at the next one

tghs2.name: Thickskinned
tghs2.desc: Pain arrives, is noted, and is set aside

tghs3.name: Brute
tghs3.desc: Punishment that would end most people barely slows you down

ttsttl1.name: Unknown
ttsttl1.desc: You barely took a single minor step into the world by gathering 10 titles. Nobody takes notice of you or your ambition, you are but a filler existence that doesn't amount to anything yet

ttsttl2.name: Nameless
ttsttl2.desc: 25 titles would be something an average working man would aquire effortlessly by simply living his life. You shouldn't feel proud by only reaching this high

ttsttl3.name: Ordinary
ttsttl3.desc: You're finally getting somewhere, having a basic set of skills and minor achievements. You could even be called reliable by some. But once again, you are feeling like a part of the mass

hstr1.name: Pathetic
hstr1.desc: Your weak punch can barely exert a power of 100kg, which is a measly amount in the martial world. A simple farmer can hit harder than this

hstr2.name: Softhitter
hstr2.desc: You got somewhat stronger in reaching 250kg worth of punch power. You can manage some physical labor with that strength, but nothing noteworthy

hstr3.name: Jawbreaker
hstr3.desc: Half ton punch isn't bad, you can successfully push a body a few meters back if you hit correctly in the right spot. This only applies to entities without strong physical protection, you are no match to anything with real strength

jbs1.name: Errand Boy
jbs1.desc: You have run enough errands for the village to know its streets by name

jbs2.name: Part-Timer
jbs2.desc: Steady work, steady pay. The postings have started to expect you

jbs3.name: Hired Hand
jbs3.desc: Whoever needs a job done in this village asks for you first

pet3.name: Wild Kid
pet3.desc: All that time you spent with your cat made you understand a whole lot about the habits and behaviour of vicious predators. You feel that knowledge might prove to be useful one day

ndthextr.name: Safehouse
ndthextr.desc: You kept yourself well and protected, avoiding danger and moving out of harm's way for quiet some time. Almost like any other person who fears for his life

demo.name: Run

scout.name: Investigate
scout.desc: Thoroughly examine current area in search for hidden passages, treasure, secrets or anything of interest

agl1.name: Athletics
agl1.desc: Drills that sharpen balance, footwork, and reaction

xtr1.name: Observation
xtr1.desc: Learning to read a room, a track, and a tell before they matter

fse1.name: Reflexes
fse1.desc: Body and eye finally moving together, faster than thought
fse1.cond: Requires one level in Physical Training, Athletics, and Observation

hstr1.name: Second Wind
hstr1.desc: The trick of finding one more push when the body says there is none
hstr1.cond: Hidden until Physical Training and Athletics are both mastered

wolvesTurned.name: Why did the wolves come north?
wolvesTurned.desc: Yamato sent you against a pack that had left its own range. Packs do not do that for nothing.

wolvesPushed.name: They were pushed
wolvesPushed.desc: Yamato had the carcasses looked at. Every wolf was underfed and most were sick. That is not a pack that came to hunt — it is a pack that was driven out of somewhere.

leaderNotWeak.name: The leader was the only healthy one
leaderNotWeak.desc: Every wolf in the forest is a Weakened Wolf. The one denning in the hollow was not, and it carried weeks-old rot in its jaw that no wolf gave it.

leaderFacedCrack.name: It died facing the crack, not you
leaderFacedCrack.desc: The pack leader had put itself between its own pack and a fissure in the rock. Whatever it was guarding them from, it was not the village.

underTheSouth.name: What is under the southern forest?
underTheSouth.desc: The fissure in the hollow breathes cold air and is far too narrow to follow. Whatever is behind it, the pack knew about it before anyone in the village did.

itDigs.name: It digs, and it does not stop
itDigs.desc: The old shopkeeper has been saying it for a month: rats scratch and rats stop when you hit the wall. This digs, it started at the oldest walls, and it spread toward the well.

lockedCellar.name: Tools go missing from locked cellars
lockedCellar.desc: A boy at the market lost his father's chisels out of a cellar that was locked, and took a beating for it. What takes tools and a lantern and leaves the food is not hungry.

mortarPushed.name: The mortar was pushed from the inside
mortarPushed.desc: Two stones at the back of your own cellar stand proud of the rest, and the powdered mortar is on your side of the wall. Nothing fell out of it. Something pressed in.

whatDigs.name: What has been digging under the village?
whatDigs.desc: It works through stone, it takes tools rather than food, and it has been at it long enough for three streets to notice.

theOrder.name: An order is buried down here
theOrder.desc: The corridor is lined with the dead of the Knights of the Cross. What walks it has kept the training: it does not simply come at you, it opens your guard first.

deadMovingNow.name: Why has the dead started moving now?
deadMovingNow.desc: These catacombs are centuries old and the village has stood above them the whole time. Something changed recently enough that people are still arguing about it at the market.

deathKiPooling.name: Death ki has been pooling here
deathKiPooling.desc: A Disaster Corpse cannot form anywhere the dark ki is not already extremely concentrated, and one was standing at the end of the corridor. The skeletons say the same thing: they harm nobody until death ki has worked on them long enough, and these had gone frenzied.

cameThrough.name: It came through, not from
cameThrough.desc: The wall at the end of the catacombs has been cut through from the far side, and the dust of the cut is still pale. Whatever is under the village did not begin here. It passed through on its way up.

warmAir.name: The air past the wall is warm
warmAir.desc: Everything above it is colder than the season. The passage beyond the cut breathes warm air, and it moves.

catacombsForgotten.name: Why were the catacombs forgotten?
catacombsForgotten.desc: Twenty-six named rooms, an order's dead, and a village that built its cellars against the entrance without one person mentioning it. Somebody stopped talking about this place on purpose.

threeAndAcross.name: Three strokes and a cross-cut
threeAndAcross.desc: A hunter's mark beside the opening, cut deep by someone with time and a good blade. Weathered along one edge only, so it has seen exactly one wet season. Below it, the broken tip of a sword in better steel than yours.

whoCameFirst.name: Who came this far before you?
whoCameFirst.desc: Someone found the end of the catacombs, marked the way, and went on down. Not long ago, and not with the village's help.

deinWasHere.name: Dein was here
deinWasHere.desc: Three-and-across is not a route mark. It is what Yamato's deputy chief cut to tell the man behind him that he had gone on alone and was not coming back the same way — half of it taught, half of it invented so Yamato would know it was him and nobody else. Dein has been missing fourteen months.

whatDeinSought.name: What was Dein looking for?
whatDeinSought.desc: He went down alone, past an order's tombs, and he marked the way as worth returning to rather than worth avoiding. He knew something before he went.

whyTheEast.name: Why does Yamato keep looking east?
whyTheEast.desc: He has mentioned an eastern expedition since before any of this, and now he is sending word there the same night he learns his deputy went under the village. He is not telling you everything about the east.

theLodge.name: The Hunter's Lodge
theLodge.desc: Head Hunter Yamato runs the lodge in the Western Woods and posts the work nobody else in the village will take. Everything that gets dealt with out here gets dealt with because he decided it should be.

monsterRanks.name: How monsters are ranked
monsterRanks.desc: The scale runs from G upward through F, E, D, C and on to SSS. It measures what a thing can do to you, not what it is — a rank is a warning, not a description. Yamato teaches it at the lodge to anyone who asks.

creatureKinds.name: The six kinds
creatureKinds.desc: Human, Beast, Undead, Evil, Phantom, Dragon. Each answers to different weapons and shrugs off different things, which is why the same blade that settles a wolf will barely mark something that was never alive.

secondWayIn.name: Dein was not looking for the catacombs
secondWayIn.desc: He bought rope, lamp oil and chalk at the market fourteen months ago and paid the stallholder to forget it. What he asked about was a second way down — one that did not go through the burial ground. He already knew the catacombs were there, and he wanted around them.

dialogue.head_hunter_yamato_first_weapon_advice: Head Hunter Yamato: You're still going around without a proper weapon? That won't do, catch this. dialogue.meat_quest_remaining: Head Hunter Yamato: Oh, so you managed to hunt down some of the animals. You still need {remaining} more chunks of meat to finish the job. Hurry before it goes bad!

dialogue.sleeping_shopkeeper_basket_offer: Sleeping Old Man: You made these, kid? Hahaha, alright, I'll take them off your hands. 15 {coin} each!
dialogue.sleeping_shopkeeper_basement_smoke_offer: Sleeping Old Man: Your basement is in bad shape? The same has been happening to other folks lately; it's not just you. Something is drilling underground right into people's homes, and then you get a cellar full of rats. A complete travesty! Some speculate there's a monster cave nearby, but nothing has been found yet. Don't fret, though; there is a solution. Smoke the pests out. Light this bag and toss it in, the deeper the better. Your entire place will fill with smog, so you'll have to leave for a few hours. Then you'll have a clean, monster-free basement at your disposal. The price is 5 {coin} silver

dialogue.herbalist_cure_grass_offer: Herbalist: Yes indeed, if you have any cure grass to sell, by all means bring it here; you can never have too much. I will take bundles of 50 for 15 {coin}
dialogue.street_merchant_welcome: Street Merchant Ran: Welcome! What would you like?
dialogue.child_trader_welcome: Hey, I've got some good stuff for you
dialogue.child_trader_hidden_book_offer: So you want something from the hidden stash, huh? Good eye! You're one of the dojo runts, and I've got just what someone like you needs. One book, 3 silver {coin}. So, what do you say?
dialogue.child_trader_second_hidden_offer: Alright, there's something else for you, snatched from some sleeping guy, and I bet it would be useful to you. Similar deal: 5 silver {coin}

After every 5 levels you reach, come here and recieve your share! You might get something really useful if you continue to improve your skills"
dialogue.instructor_this_is_a_good_start_congratu: "Instructor: This is a good start, congratulations! Keep working hard!"
dialogue.instructor_you_seem_to_not_neglect_your_: "Instructor: You seem to not neglect your training, good job! Keep working hard!"

dialogue.instructor_yamato_sent_something_great_t: "Instructor: Yamato sent something? Great timing on that, we were getting very close to running out already. Here, small compensation for your timely delivery"
dialogue.instructor_hold_it_that_s_not_all_catch_: "Instructor: Hold it, that's not all, catch this as well, i believe it is yours. You won't be as lucky next time and lose your possessions for good if you leave them around again, pay better attention to where your stuff is"

dialogue.fight_dummies_provided_by_dojo_to_improv: Fight dummies provided by dojo to improve your physique and weapon skills! Destroy them and grab their stuff, or vanquish thousands for a special reward! The doors of our dojo is open for everyone willing to lead the path of a warrior
dialogue.when_you_are_confident_in_your_skills_tr: When you are confident in your skills, try your fist at fighting powerful golems! How much beating can you withstand?
dialogue.as_long_as_you_keep_gaining_experience_a: As long as you keep gaining experience and train hard, dojo will provide you with gifts and money! Don't miss out!
dialogue.weekly_free_meals: Our generous dojo provides Free Meals to every attending low-class disciple every Sunday! Get in time for your weekly menu!
free_meal_reactions: A little dry but, that will do
dialogue.instructor_great_job_smashing_that_golem: Instructor: Great job smashing that golem! This golem is one of the weakest types around, but even he can become a huge trouble if you're not giving it your best. Now, grab this and proceed with your training
dialogue.instructor_just_like_that_keep_it_up_you: Instructor: Just like that, keep it up. You are starting to stand much longer in fights, such an improvement from when you just arrived here! You deserver your praise, but don't get complacent
dialogue.instructor_that_was_a_tough_one_but_you_: Instructor: That was a tough one, but you still managed to crush it! You are getting close to finishing a second course. Don't give up!
dialogue.instructor_as_expected_you_have_what_it_: Instructor: As expected, you have what it takes to protect yourself! You better prepare yourself well before that happens!

dialogue.indeed_bones_skeletal_remains_of_a_perso: Indeed, bones. Skeletal remains of a person to be exact. Looks like he died long time ago, much of everything rotted off, even metallic bits of whatever armor he was wearing have fallen apart.
dialogue.there_isn_t_much_you_can_take_with_5d1a1: There isn't much you can take with you, except for the sword on the skeleton's hip, still inside its half-desintegrated sheath. What was the cause of his death? He wasn't in a fight judging by the state of the sword. Was he poisoned? Or caught by surprise? Couldn't leave this place for whatever reason? You are not sure. The least you can do is honor the deceased by burying his remains
dialogue.your_good_deed_improved_your_karma_28bfe: Your good deed improved your karma!

dialogue.head_hunter_yamato_you_why_do_you_have_4: Head Hunter Yamato: You! Why do you have that?
dialogue.head_hunter_yamato_the_sword_where_did_y: Head Hunter Yamato: The sword! Where did you get it!?
dialogue.head_hunter_yamato_the_body_in_the_fores: Head Hunter Yamato: The body in the forest, you say... Dammit! Our scouts are worthless if it takes someone like you to make such an important discovery! *sigh..* This sword you're holding once belonged to our deputy chief - Dein. You might have not met him before if you never set your foot out of the village, he was a promising and talented young soldier who were assigned to such an remote settlement for his field training
dialogue.head_hunter_yamato_then_one_day_he_staig: Head Hunter Yamato: Then one day he staight up vanished, without letting anyone know, and he was well respected and cared for our people all the same. Of course, being a part of the military would prevent him from disclosing his plans and duties, but it is highly doubtful a special task from the higher command would be the reason of his abscence. All of his belongins, personal items and possessions are still there, where he left them. G - Can be dealth with by able people
F - Can be dealth with by male adults
E - Village Crisis
D - Townside Crisis
C - Citywide Crisis
B - National Crisis
A - Continental Threat
S - Global Crisis
SS - World Disaster
SSS - Universal Calamity
We haven't experienced anything stronger than the E rank in all history of our village. Whatever is above the A rank is completely unheard of, and only partially mentioned in ancient texts. That's the realm of gods, world destroyers and higher beings that our mortal souls are unlikely to ever face
dialogue.head_hunter_yamato_monsters_you_say_ther:
Head Hunter Yamato: Monsters, you say? There are many and they are around, terrorizing peaceful folk in the outside world. Our remote parts don't see much of that, these lands are tame. Not without dangers, of course, you meet a wild boar in the forest - a single wrong move and its tusks are in your guts and that is it, end of the fool. Or those pesky slimes, while don't look menacing and pose little danger, they sometimes gather and destroy the fields by melting crops and soil. We have it good but starvation is worse than any monster, at times. *cough* anyway, anything living and non-living you meet can be separated into 6 categories:
Human, Beast, Undead, Evil, Phantom, Dragon
dialogue.head_hunter_yamato_humans_and_demihumans: Head Hunter Yamato: Humans and Demihumans fall into the same class. People like you and me, beastmen, orcs, goblins... Mostly creatures intelligent enough to walk on their two, use tools, form societies, make settlements, trade and speak on their own violition. You will encounter and perhaps fight them as bandits, criminals, members of the opposing factions and armies, whoever you disagree with. Always be on your guard, humanoids are cunning and skilled, versatile and very adaptive. Yet, they have mushy bodies. One correct strike and you get an advantage
dialogue.head_hunter_yamato_beasts_are_your_usual: Head Hunter Yamato: Beasts are your usual, normal wildlife like wolves, slimes, mimics, or prone to being evil Demihumans with low intelligence and high level of aggression like ogres, harpies, minotaurs. While animals are dumb, never underestimate a wild beast. With their thick skin and natural weapons like fangs and claws, they pose a major threat when driven into a desperate state. Fire works very well against the most, especially those with fur and feathers, keep that in mind next time you go hunting
dialogue.head_hunter_yamato_undead_as_you_could_a: Head Hunter Yamato: Undead, as you could already tell, are living dead. Reanimated remains of humans and beasts by the influence of natural forces or a skilled necromancer. Even if they completely lack intelligence and wander around aimlessly, controlled bodies of the dead get strenghtened by Dark magic and gain unnatural resilience and power as a result. It doesn't prevent them from being hurt by fire or Holy powers, hovewer. You can deal with lesser fragile skeletal beings quickly if you bash them with something blunt
dialogue.head_hunter_yamato_beings_that_are_artif: Head Hunter Yamato: Beings that are artificially made or existences who are inherently evil, can be classified as such. Demons, imps, golems, possessed weapons and armor, gremlins, devils and much of anything else that comes out from the Underworld. dialogue.head_hunter_yamato_souls_of_the_dead_eth: Head Hunter Yamato: Souls of the dead, ethereal beings, manifestations of powers or other apparitions can all be called Phantoms. They take forms of wisp and sprites, benevolent or twisted elementals or spirits and wraiths that terrorize the living. They are difficult or sometimes outright impossible to hurt using normal physical means, magic or exorcism would be a preferred way of dealing with such enemies
dialogue.head_hunter_yamato_dragons_are_legendary: Head Hunter Yamato: Dragons are legendary creatures that possess evil and cunning intellect. dialogue.pack_leader_posting: The pack leader — Yamato's own request
dialogue.yamato_pack_leader_brief:
Head Hunter Yamato: I said I would send for you. I would have, in a day or two; you have saved me a runner.

I had the carcasses looked at. Every wolf you brought down was underfed, and most of them were sick. That is not a pack that came north to hunt us. That is a pack that was pushed.

Something holds the deep south now, and it is not a wolf. The leader knows what it is: it kept the pack between itself and that thing, and it did not choose us. Find the hollow past the foliage.

And hunter, look before you kill. If you find what pushed them, you come back to me before you touch it.
dialogue.yamato_pack_leader_waiting: Head Hunter Yamato: The hollow is past the foliage, not in this room. Go on.
dialogue.yamato_pack_leader_report:
Head Hunter Yamato: Sit down. You are bleeding on my floor.

Rot in a wolf's jaw, weeks old, and it still held its ground. Against what, if not us? You saw the crack. So did it: it died facing the crack, not facing you.

Take the mask. It was cut from the last thing I hunted that had no business existing, and I have no use for keepsakes.

Something is under the ground, hunter. The south, and now the village. The old shopkeeper by the cellars has been saying for a month that something is digging under people's homes, and I called him a drunk to his face. Go and hear him out properly. I will send word east; if this is what I think it is, the two of us will not be enough.
dialogue.hollow_signs: The ground gives way into a bowl of dead pine. There are bones here and not all of them belong to prey: a wolf's own skull, cracked open, half buried in needles. The claw marks on the trunks run higher than any wolf could reach. Under the roots on the far side, cold air is coming up out of the rock.
dialogue.hollow_aftermath:
The leader lies where it fell, and up close it is a poor ruined thing: ribs like a fence, one eye gone milky, the rot in its jaw old enough to have set into the bone. It is facing the crack in the rocks, not facing you.

The crack breathes. It is far too narrow to follow, and the air coming out of it is colder than the season has any right to be.
dialogue.shopkeeper_digging_account:
Sleeping Old Man: The Head Hunter sent you. Him. After a month.

Under the floors, is what I have been saying. Not rats — rats scratch, and rats stop when you hit the wall. This digs, and it does not stop for anything. Mine started at the back of the cellar, where the old wall is. Then the family two doors down. Then the houses by the well.

And things go missing. Not food, which would at least make sense to me. Tools. A lantern. My wife's good knife. Whatever is taking them is not hungry, and that sits worse with me than if it were.

Ask at the market if you like. They will tell you I am a drunk. Then go and look at your own cellar wall, hunter. Look at it properly.
dialogue.market_rumours:
The fishmonger laughs before you have finished the question. The old man has been on about his cellar since spring, and before that it was wolves in the grain store, and before that it was his wife's cousin taking from the till.

The woman at the next stall does not laugh. She says the well has been coming up cloudy for three weeks, and that nobody wants to discuss it because the alternative to drinking it is not drinking.

A carter tells you it is the old drainage settling. The village was built on top of something older, everyone knows this, and it means nothing.

Then a boy who has been listening the whole time says his father's chisels went missing out of a locked cellar, and that his father beat him for losing them, and asks you not to repeat it.
dialogue.basement_wall_examined:
The back of your cellar is older than the rest of the house. The courses run differently, and someone has patched it more than once with whatever was to hand.

Two of the stones near the floor sit proud of the others. Not fallen out — pushed. The mortar around them has gone to powder, and the powder is on your side of the wall.

You put your hand flat over the gap. The air coming through it is moving, and it is colder than the season, and it smells like the inside of a jar that has been shut a long time.

Something is on the other side of your wall, and it has been for a while.
dialogue.report_what_is_under_the_village: Report what is under the village
dialogue.yamato_undercity_briefing:
Head Hunter Yamato: A locked cellar. Say that part again.

...No. I heard you. Tools out of a locked cellar, mortar pushed from the inside, and the well going cloudy. That is not something that wandered in off the woods and lost its way.

I owe the old man an apology, and he is not getting it, because he would enjoy it far too much.

Go down. I will not tell you to wait for me — by the time I have men, whatever is under your floor will have had another month at it. But hear this first: it is dark down there, and dark is not an inconvenience. It is how things like that hunt. You will not see well enough to swing straight, and you will not see them coming at all.

Buy candles. Every candle the general store has. And when your light goes out you turn around, whatever you happen to be standing next to. That is not advice, hunter. That is the whole of it.
dialogue.basement_wall_opened:
The two proud stones come out with the flat of a tool, and the rest comes away in your hands like wet bread. Behind them the gap runs back further than your arm, and then it stops being a gap and starts being a room.

The air rising out of it is old and still, and it moves anyway. Somewhere past where your light reaches, water is going where it has been going for a very long time.

Your candle will not last as long as you would like it to.
dialogue.journey_end_guardian:
The corridor stops. Not at a wall — at a room that was meant to be the last one, with eleven empty niches behind you and nothing ahead but a floor swept smooth by something moving across it, over and over, for a long time.

What is standing in the middle of it has not decayed, because it was never alive to begin with. It is the shape a man makes, held together by whatever has been pooling down here, and it has been waiting long enough to wear a path into stone.

The cold is coming from behind it.
dialogue.journey_end_aftermath:
It comes apart rather than falls, and what is left on the floor is not a body. It is the parts of a great many people, none of them recent.

Behind where it stood, the wall is not a wall. The stone has been cut through from the far side, and the cut is not old — the dust is still pale. The passage beyond keeps going down, and the air rising out of it is not cold at all. It is warm, and it moves.

Whatever has been digging under the village did not start here. It came through here.
dialogue.journey_end_deins_mark:
There is a hunter's mark cut into the stone beside the opening. Three strokes and a cross-cut.

It is cut deep, by someone with time and a good blade, and it is weathered along one edge only, which means it has been here through one wet season and no more.

Wedged into the crack below it, where the blade could not reach to pry it out, is the broken-off tip of a sword. It is good steel. It is far better steel than anything you own.

Someone came this far before you, marked the way, and went down.
dialogue.how_far_down_posting: How far it goes — Yamato's request
dialogue.yamato_how_far_down_brief:
Head Hunter Yamato: You came back. Good. I had half decided who I would be sending after you.

Now the part I have been turning over since you left. A hole under a village is a hole. Something that digs under a village, through a burial ground, and keeps going, is not interested in the village.

I want to know how far it runs, and what is at the bottom of the part a man can walk. Not the bottom of all of it. The bottom of what you can walk with a candle.

Take everything you can carry. If the far end is what I think it is, you will not want to be counting candles when you get to it.
dialogue.yamato_how_far_down_waiting: Head Hunter Yamato: The far end of it, hunter. Not the near end.
dialogue.report_the_mark_on_the_wall: Report the mark on the wall
dialogue.yamato_dein_reveal:
Head Hunter Yamato: Three strokes and a cross-cut. Say it again. Three, and then across.

...Sit down. No — stay standing, it makes no difference.

That is not a route mark. It is close enough that anyone trained here would read it as one, but it is not. Three and across is what my deputy cut when he wanted the man behind him to know he had gone on alone and was not coming back the same way. I taught him half of it. He invented the rest so I would know it was him and nobody else.

Dein. Fourteen months. I took a sword with his mark on it off a boy in this marketplace and I told the boy I would look into it, and I did look, and I found nothing, and then I stopped looking.

And he was under our feet.

The steel you found — give it to me. No. Keep it. Keep it somewhere you can put your hand on it.

You are not going back down there this week. Neither am I, and I want to, which is precisely why not. Whatever is at the bottom of that passage got past him, and he was better than you and he was better than me.

Rest. Eat. I am sending word east tonight, and this time it is not a courtesy. Then you and I are going to find out what my deputy chief walked into.
dialogue.instructor_level_35: Instructor: You have stopped coming here to learn and started coming here to be told you have not forgotten. That is fine, it is what the room is for. Take the shield off the west wall — it is Hoplite work, older than the dojo, and heavier than anything you will want to carry until the day you are glad you did.
dialogue.instructor_level_40: Instructor: There is nothing left in my hands that will make you hit harder. So take this instead. It is a medal, and it does nothing in a fight; what it does is make everything you practise stick faster. Wear it and stop asking me for swords.
dialogue.instructor_level_45: Instructor: Jade skin, they used to call it. I have no idea if it works and I have never needed to find out. Take the knight's shield with it — you are past the age where I can pretend you are training rather than working.
dialogue.instructor_level_50:
Instructor: Fifty. I have taught two people who got this far and I buried one of them.

The dread shield is not a gift, it is a loan from the dojo and it goes back on that wall when you are done with it. The medicine is a gift. Use it before you need it, not after — that is the last thing I have to teach you.
dialogue.nervous_guy_approaches: The nervous man is watching the road rather than his stall, and when he sees you he does not look away. He has been waiting for someone. He gets halfway through a sentence twice before he manages the start of it.
dialogue.tell_him_it_is_not_his_fault: Tell him it is not his fault
dialogue.nervous_guy_confession:
Nervous Man: You let me be. The once. Everyone else in this market has had a go at me and you let me be, so it is going to be you.

Fourteen months. A hunter came to this stall — good coat, better sword, the kind that does not haggle. Rope. Lamp oil. A box of chalk. He paid over the odds and he asked me to forget he had been here, and I said yes, because he paid over the odds.

Then he never came back past me. And then the Head Hunter started asking after a man, and I said nothing, because I had already been paid to say nothing and a month had gone by and what was I going to say then?

I have stood here for fourteen months with that. Do you know what that is like.
dialogue.nervous_guy_second_way:
Nervous Man: He wanted to know about a second way down.

Not the burial ground — he knew about that, he said so, he said it like a man saying a thing he had already decided against. He wanted to know if there was another way under the village that did not go through it.

I told him about the old drain by the mill, because it was the only hole I know of and I wanted him to go away. He wrote it down. Chalk and rope and a hole he had to be told about by a man selling turnips.

He was not lost, hunter. He was going around something on purpose.

dialogue.catacombs_candles: A niche in the wall holds a row of candle stubs, set out by someone who expected to come back for them.
dialogue.catacombs_grave_coins: Coins, laid out in a pattern you do not recognise. Whoever left them meant them to stay where they were.
dialogue.catacombs_lantern: A lantern, on its side, wick still damp. It has not been down here a month — and the old shopkeeper said his was taken.
dialogue.catacombs_stolen_tools: Bone and rag, piled the way something piles the parts it has no use for. A chisel handle is in the heap, worn smooth by a hand.
dialogue.market_discard: Something is lying where a stall was packed up: a botched piece of work its maker could not sell and would not carry home.
